title: list node response
description: Where the backend is linux: standard output of list node in JSON mode (LIST-142), or a refusal. The command is the Linux backend's own (overview 2.1), so there is no base or noos shape. ListNodeResponse in src/backends/linux/protocol/types.ts.

oneOf.description: list node (LIST-140 to LIST-142): the nodes of the merged tree, depth first in tree order, the root first; with a filter, those it matches (LIST-143).

message.description: <n> node[s], or <n> node[s] match[es] "<filter>" with a filter (LIST-142, LIST-143).

key.description: The node's name with its unit address (gpio@7e200000); / for the root.

labels.description: The base's labels, then the overlay's.

compatible.description: Its compatible strings, in order; none without a compatible.

status.description: Its status property (okay, disabled, ...), when it has one.

origin.description: As read's: internal when the overlay adds or changes the node, external when only the base has it.

change.description: added: none of its properties is the base's and the overlay sets one or adds it; changed: the overlay sets a property of a base node; none otherwise (LIST-141).
